# Sriraj Guttapalyam: technical writing portfolio

> Senior technical writer with 10+ years of experience in API documentation, docs-as-code, AI-assisted documentation workflows, and structured authoring. The samples use public or fictional products.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): overview, samples, experience
- [Review map](PORTFOLIO_CONTENT_GUIDE.md): where each skill shows and how the samples are checked
- [Authorship and validation](projects/portfolio-evidence/README.md): human decisions, AI assistance, checks, and limitations

## Flagship samples
- [API reference](projects/api-reference/README.md): GitHub REST parameters, pagination, nullable fields, and error recovery
- [Webhook integration](projects/webhook-integration/README.md): HMAC-SHA256 verification, idempotency, and unit-tested Python
- [Docs as code](projects/docs-as-code/README.md): pull-request review, source checks, and Docusaurus build validation
- [AI documentation case study](projects/ai-ready-content/README.md): retrieval baseline, metadata, limitations, and human-in-the-loop workflow

## AI and content strategy
- [AI-ready content](projects/ai-ready-content/README.md): chunking, metadata, and a hand-run retrieval test
- [AI workflows](projects/ai-workflows/README.md): human-in-the-loop process, prompts, agent rules, style checklist
- [Cursor + MadCap Flare workflow](projects/cursor-flare-workflow/README.md): multi-source synthesis from Jira, Confluence, Teams, email, video, and QA into Flare XHTML
- [Information architecture](projects/doc-architecture/README.md): content model, taxonomy, reuse, governance
